title: Confused calibration follow up
symptom: When starting a G6 with a code, there is a large signal error (usually 2-4 mmol too high). Calibrating can cause a confused calibration state, after which the sensor stops giving data. There is a brief window to send a new calibration, but if missed, the sensor stays crashed.
cause: The G6 sensor enters a confused calibration state during calibration, and xDrip turns off the calibration menu item after a few minutes of confusion, preventing recovery.
fix: Use the syringe icon and enter a blood test value to send a calibration to the transmitter. Alternatively, use 'Initial calibration' after disabling double calibration, and avoid calibrating when the trend is not flat.
evidence_quote: If you use the syringe icon and enter a blood test value this should send it to the transmitter as a calibration.
